# Release workflow

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Release pipeline · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

.github/workflows/release.yml (push + dispatch, unique v<major.minor.run> tag, non-draft release with installers, no test or lint job, RELEASE_TOKEN then ORG_TOKEN then GITHUB_TOKEN); scripts/local-checks.mjs (release notes state the checks run before the commit only when the record matches the released files); tests/local-checks.test.ts

## What is missing

a release made by the changed workflow read back with the new note lines
